daily.today_energy: Mercury's vibe is hitting different today—your mind is sharp and you're picking up on things others miss. This is your moment to trust those gut feelings and let your natural wisdom lead.
daily.love: Someone's been thinking about you more than you realize. Whether it's deepening an existing bond or a new connection forming, the energy says vulnerability is actually your superpower rn.
daily.career: Your efforts from last week are about to get noticed in ways that matter. Stay focused on what you can control and let your work speak—momentum is building behind the scenes.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement and fresh air today. Even a short walk or stretching session will shift your whole energy. Listen to what feels good instead of pushing through.

weekly.overview: This week invites you to balance your ambitious nature with genuine rest. Mercury's energy suggests clarity in communication, so speak your truth without overthinking. Trust the quiet moments as much as the productive ones.
weekly.love: If you're coupled up, vulnerability is your superpower rn. Single? Someone's been lowkey observing your vibe. Don't force connections—let things unfold naturally. Your authenticity is magnetic this week.
weekly.career: Your ideas have serious potential energy right now. Pitch that project or share your vision with someone who matters. Recognition might come from unexpected places. Stay grounded in your efforts, not the outcomes.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for intentional movement and actual rest days. Not punishment workouts—things that feel good. Hydration and sleep hit different this week. Check in with what your nervous system actually needs.
